title: Witch Hat Atelier Anime Reveals 3rd Ending Theme Song
content: The staff for the television anime of Kamome Shirahama 's Witch Hat Atelier manga announced on Tuesday that Nakamura Hak performs the third ending theme song for the anime titled "Hikari" (Light).
author: ANN

title: Additional Cast Pair for 'Tongari Boushi no Atelier' Announced
content: The official website of the Tongari Boushi no Atelier ( Witch Hat Atelier ) TV anime revealed additional cast members this Tuesday. The anime series adapting Kamome Shirahama 's fantasy manga began airing on April 6 at 11:00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, BS11, followed by KBS Kyoto, Sun TV, and AT-X.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Graduation Arrives in Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 Episode 5 Preview
content: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 has revealed the preview images and synopsis for Episode 5 (Episode 17 overall). Crunchyroll is streaming the anime worldwide, with Episode 5 scheduled to premiere on May 10.
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga Adaptation of Kei Takano's Shokei Flag Mansai no Kiraware Ōji no Yarinaoshi Novels Ends
content: The June issue of Ichijinsha 's Monthly Comic Rex magazine published on April 27 the final chapter of Tatsuichi Fuchika's Shokei Flag Mansai no Kiraware Ōji no Yarinaoshi (Redoing the Hated Prince of the Execution Flag) manga, the adaptation of writer Kei Takano and artist Shoa Takashima's light novels of the same…
author: ANN

title: King of the Hill Reboot Teases Luanne Tribute for New Hulu Season
content: King of the Hill is coming back for a new season of its revival series with Hulu later this Summer, and it’s teasing that fans will finally find out what happened to Luanne with its new episodes.
author: ComicBook

title: At Home with a Girl in Her Cute Pajamas Manga Listed to End With 3rd Volume
content: Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service publishes the manga and describes the story: All his life, Manamichi has only known how to study. But summer break, he's tasked with delivering homework to his classmate, Makura Koiro.
author: ANN

title: Nao Emoto Draws Maryoku Zero no Saikyō Kenja Manga Based on Shinkoshoto's Story

author: ANN

title: Classic NickToon Character Was Removed by Nickelodeon For Being “Too Weird”
content: In the history of Nickelodeon’s original animated universes, referred to as “NickToons,” there have been some downright bizarre faces that have made up the cable network’s roster.
author: ComicBook

title: April Showers Bring May Flowers' Roku Sakura Launches New Manga on June 4
content: The June issue of Kadokawa 's Young Ace magazine revealed last Saturday that Roku Sakura will launch a new romantic comedy manga titled Osananajimi o Shiawase ni Suru Made Shinenai!! (I Won't Die Until I've Made My Childhood Friend Happy!!) in the magazine's next issue on June 4.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Confirms Sudden Dub Delay for Their Coolest Spring 2026 Anime
content: One of Crunchyroll ‘s coolest Spring 2026 anime releases has been hit with a sudden delay for the English dub, but the streaming service has confirmed the new release date for its next planned episode.
author: ComicBook
